sourceOccurrences.note: The seven named theorems concern ball-count upper bounds, radial sums, total mass at most 2C, descent to unordered pairs, and three intensity applications. 9408 and 6KJQ give stronger exact shell formulas; these are not attributed to the source, which proves only upper bounds. B6KD includes its conservative 2C susceptibility and threshold bounds and the d=1, L=2, C=1, r=1/4 witness. The algebraic descent also holds at zero modulus without the nonzero-modulus assumption used for the finite ball counts; the final paragraph explains this separate scope. KL29 is an expository addition.
